item.title: Teen dead, another hurt in double shooting in South Phoenix
item.description: A teen is dead and another is injured following a shooting in South Phoenix overnight, according to the Phoenix Police Department. The shooting happened just after 2 a.m. on Feb. 28 near 5400 South 19th Avenue. Two teen boys were found with at least one gunshot wound. One was taken to a nearby hospital with life-threatening injuries, where he later died. The other victim took himself to a nearby hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
